SEC releases the 2027 university entrance examination programs

10 September 2026

Azerbaijan's State Examination Center has published the programs for the second stage of the 2027 university entrance examinations and confirmed that the 2026 exam model will remain in use.

PISA 2025 results: Azerbaijan's nationwide-scale participation results released

8 September 2026

Azerbaijan participated in PISA 2025 on a nationwide scale for the first time, with 7,432 students from 241 schools. The Ministry reported large gains in mathematics, science and reading compared with the previous cycle, while noting that the 2018 and 2022 samples covered only Baku.

Qarabağ University and Istanbul Technical University expand engineering cooperation

28 August 2026

Engineering cooperation between Qarabağ University and Istanbul Technical University is being expanded, with dual-degree programs, student and faculty exchanges, joint research and engineering infrastructure planned.
